newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Goldtron unit sells 21.5 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Goldtron unit sells 21.5 mln shares.

text.p: Electronics group Goldtron Ltd said on Tuesday it had sold 21.5 million shares of Goldtronics Sdn Bhd (GSB) for 20 million ringgit.

The sale was made by its subsidiary Goldmarket Assets Ltd (GAL) to Jaffar Mohd Ali and represented 28.9 percent of the issued share capital of GSB, Goldtron said in a statement. Jaffar is a non-executive chairman of GSB.
After the sale, GAL's shareholding in GSB is 48.1 percent.
GSB is a Malaysian company which operates a video tape loading assembly plant.
